nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic and incremented by mint.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances in BasicToken.
Nested allowance mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) in StandardToken.
Owner address stored by Ownable and used by onlyOwner modifier.
Pausable flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
SlotTicket instance deployed in the Slot constructor and minted on ticket purchase.
Mapping(uint=>mapping(uint=>address)) game number => index => participant address.
Array of fixed prize amounts paid out each round.
Accumulated jackpot balance, topped up each round and reset when won.
Current game index, incremented after each prize awarding round.
House wallet that receives the cash-register cut of each round.
Global participant counter driving game boundaries and refundAll loop.
BasicToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to _to.
BasicToken.balanceOf: reads the balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom: allowance-based transfer updating balances and allowed.
StandardToken.approve: sets allowance with zero-allowance guard.
StandardToken.allowance: reads the allowed mapping.
SlotTicket.mint, onlyOwner, increases totalSupply and balances.
SlotTicket.destroy, onlyOwner, selfdestructs the ticket token contract.
Slot constructor: deploys SlotTicket, sets wallet, jackpot, gameNumber and counter.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.sender to buyTicketsFor.
Payable ticket purchase: computes tickets, mints tokens, registers participants and refunds change.
Private loop writing participants and triggering awardPrizes when a game fills.
Private pseudo-random generator based on blockhash.
Private payout routine: draws winner, pays prizes, jackpot, wallet and gas refund, increments gameNumber.
Private jackpot payout to the winner index, then resets jackpot.
Owner-only refund of unfinished game participants and counter reduction.
Slot.destroy, onlyOwner, destroys ticket token and selfdestructs.
Owner-only update of the house wallet address.
Ownable.transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner.
Pausable.pause, onlyOwner + whenNotPaused, sets paused true.
Pausable.unpause, onlyOwner + whenPaused, sets paused false.
Caller address used for balances, ownership, beneficiary and ether refunds.
selfdestruct(owner) executed inside SlotTicket.destroy.
msg.sender.transfer(change) inside buyTicketsFor, an external call to the caller.
participants[gameNumber][winnerIndex%SIZE].transfer(prizes[i]) inside awardPrizes.
wallet.transfer(2.49 finney) cash-register payment inside awardPrizes.
msg.sender.transfer(0.01 finney) gas reimbursement inside awardPrizes.
participants[gameNumber][_winnerIndex].transfer(jackpot) inside distributeJackpot.
participants[gameNumber][i].transfer(PRICE) inside refundAll.
keccak256 of block.blockhash values used as pseudo-randomness in rand.
SafeMath add/sub arithmetic applied to balances and supply.
counter -= counter%SIZE arithmetic in refundAll.
selfdestruct(owner) executed inside Slot.destroy.
buyTicketsFor parameter; address receiving tickets.
Change amount returned to msg.sender in buyTicketsFor.
Number of tickets derived from msg.value in buyTicketsFor.
addParticipant parameter written into the participants mapping.
addParticipant parameter bounding the registration loop.
Random winning index used in awardPrizes.
Boolean flag gating jackpot distribution in awardPrizes.
rand parameter used as modulus.
distributeJackpot parameter selecting the jackpot recipient.
mint parameter for the minted amount.
mint parameter for the credited address.
changeWallet parameter assigned to wallet.
transferOwnership parameter assigned to owner.

normalization_plan.reason: beneficiary is only read inside buyTicketsFor and passed on to addParticipant and token.mint.
change is a temporary remainder computed and immediately transferred inside buyTicketsFor.
numberOfTickets is derived from msg.value in buyTicketsFor and consumed by addParticipant.
_participant is only stored into the participants mapping inside addParticipant.
_numberOfTickets only bounds the loop inside addParticipant.
winnerIndex is a loop-local random index in awardPrizes used for prize payout.
jackpotWon is a local boolean in awardPrizes gating distributeJackpot.
_size is the modulus parameter of the rand helper.
_winnerIndex is only used inside distributeJackpot to select the jackpot receiver.
_amount is the minted value parameter of SlotTicket.mint.
_to is the credit target parameter of SlotTicket.mint.
_newWallet is validated and assigned to wallet inside changeWallet.
newOwner is validated and assigned to owner inside transferOwnership.
